items.title: Spire Global, Inc. Q1 2026 Results (8-K exhibit)
items.snippet: First quarter 2026 revenue was $15.8 million, above the high end of the guidance range, down 34% year-over-year, and up 13% excluding the maritime business.

items.title: Spire Global, Inc. 10-Q for quarter ended March 31, 2026
items.snippet: The filing discusses remaining performance obligations and customer demand diversification across government and commercial customers.
